info.name: JFrog ML REST API
info.description:
API for managing machine learning models, experiments, and deployments including model registry, versioning, and serving capabilities. JFrog ML (formerly Qwak) provides end-to-end MLOps features integrated with the JFrog Platform.

Contact Support:
 Name: JFrog
